annotation.title_clean: 人力资源社会保障部等4部门关于支持海洋经济发展促进就业创业的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice of Four Ministries Including the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security on Supporting Marine Economy Development and Promoting Employment and Entrepreneurship
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 人力资源社会保障部; 自然资源部; 国家发展改革委; 交通运输部
annotation.summary_en: Chinese four-ministry notice (No. 32 of 2026) on supporting marine economy development to promote employment and entrepreneurship, covering traditional and emerging marine industries, seafarer workforce, skills training and labour rights. AI is mentioned only in passing; no robotics governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Stabilise and expand employment in traditional marine industries and cultivate new marine sectors
Apply tax, social insurance and training subsidies to employers and trainees
Launch 'Blue Craftsman' training and 'bringing land to sea' technology transfer plans
Protect seafarers' rights: social insurance, minimum wage, model contracts, maritime labour inspections
Build statistics system for marine employment
